onboarding.title: Hi, I'm halo.
onboarding.body: A helper that lives on your phone. I listen when you ask, and what's yours stays yours.

onboarding.title: You choose where I think.
onboarding.body: Start private. You can change this anytime in Settings.
options: Use your own computer or server.
Most capable. Sent to a provider you pick.

onboarding.title: I only listen when you ask.
onboarding.body: Turn things on now or later. Nothing runs in secret.
perms: For voice. Only after you tap or say the wake word.
Reminders, and when I need your OK.
Later, and only for actions you approve.

onboarding.title: You're helping build me.
onboarding.body: halo is in alpha. Some things will break. When they do, I'll show you instead of hiding it.
bullets: halo is open source on GitHub.

devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: Your phone and what's connected to it
devices.empty_body: Add glasses so halo can see and hear with you, or BuddyBot for your desk.
devices.headphones_note: Headphones connect in Android Bluetooth. halo uses them automatically.
devices.abilities_note: halo always asks before it acts on your phone. Change any of this in Permissions.
devices.chooser_sub: What would you like halo to work with?
devices.glasses_sub: halo sees and hears with you
devices.pair_check_close: Keep them close to your phone
devices.which_is_mine: Not sure which is yours? Hold your glasses next to the phone. They'll move to the top.
devices.code_question: Does this code match your glasses?
devices.ready_body: halo can now hear and speak through them.
devices.fail_connect_body: Your glasses may still be paired to another phone. Forget them there, then try again.
devices.fail_quiet_body: They may have switched off or moved away. Bring them closer.
devices.fail_unsupported_body: halo can't use these glasses yet. We'll tell you when it can.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Make halo feel like yours
settings.kids_mode_sub: Simpler screens and kinder words for children. Settings stay behind a parent lock.
settings.check_setup_sub: See what works, share a report
settings.cloud_mark_note: Replies that used the cloud carry this mark in chat.
settings.model_downloading: Downloading on Wi-Fi · halo keeps working
settings.cloud_ask_note: “Ask me” shows a one-tap Allow before any message leaves your phone.
settings.voice_test_sub: Say something. I'll show what I hear.
settings.permissions_intro: halo asks before using anything new, and before every action on your phone.

principles.confident: Say what halo will do, in the first person, then do it.
principles.welcoming: Plain, warm words. Talk with people, never at them.
principles.transparent: Say where it happens, what it touches, and why.

rewrites.Configuration is saved. Check the connec: One quick test and you're ready.
rewrites.Mode: Automatic: I'll pick Ask or Act, and check with you before I touch your phone.
rewrites.Task paused: “{task}” is paused at step {n}. Pick up where I left off?
rewrites.Cancelled · Interaction interrupted: Stopped when you interrupted. Nothing was changed.
rewrites.Enter a learning goal or choose material: What would you like to learn? I'll take it from there.
Searching won't connect anything until you choose.
rewrites.Verify and compare image models: Compare how models see a photo
rewrites.Try an audio file with an installed mode: Try a recording on this phone
rewrites.Allow: (use the action verb: Send it, Open it, Set it)

guide.test_title: One quick test and you're ready
guide.test_body: About 5 seconds. Nothing leaves your phone.
